title: Truck Machine Beat
hook: Name the job before the machine beat.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D road-vehicle storybook, toy-like vehicles, safe roads, clean silhouettes; visual identity: Truck Machine Beat

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child sorting vehicle work roles
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Truck Machine Beat about service-versus-machine role: ambulance, bus, delivery, waste, utility and pickup transport people/goods/services; forklift/loader/roller do work; aircraft/kayak are mode exceptions.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child asks whether the object transports, serves, lifts, compacts, or flies/floats before naming it a truck or machine.
